body:
## Quick facts for brands and buyers

| | |
|---|---|
| **Minimum order (MOQ)** | 15 to 20 pieces per design |
| **Sample time** | 7 to 8 days |
| **Bulk production** | About 15 days for 100 pieces, after sample approval |
| **Payment** | 50% advance, balance before dispatch |
| **Labels** | Your neck label, wash-care label, hang tags and packaging |
| **Sizes** | XS to 5XL, plus custom size grading on request |
| **Shipping** | Across India and worldwide – USA, UK, Europe, Canada, Australia and the Middle East |

## Your brand, made in Jaipur

Bahe Kurtiz makes women's ethnic wear in our own unit in Jaipur, the home of hand block printing. We help new labels, Instagram and website brands, boutiques and international importers launch collections under their own name, without the high minimums of large factories.

You can start with our proven designs and add your label, or develop your own designs from a sketch, reference photo or tech pack.

## What we make

- **Kurtis and tunics:** straight, A-line, short tunic tops for jeans
- **Kurta sets:** kurta pant, kurta palazzo and three-piece sets with dupatta
- **Anarkali suits:** taffeta silk, georgette, chiffon and velvet
- **Co-ord sets and dresses:** cotton co-ords, block print maxi dresses, linen midi dresses
- **Dupattas:** Kota Doria, organza and cotton

### Crafts and fabrics

- **Hand block printing:** Sanganeri, Bagru and Dabu-style prints – see our [guide to Jaipur block prints](/blog/sanganeri-bagru-and-dabu-print-a-simple-guide-to-jaipur-block-prints/)
- **Embroidery and handwork:** thread work, gota patti, sequins and lace
- **Fabrics:** cotton, Kota Doria, chanderi, georgette, chiffon, taffeta silk, velvet and linen

## Two ways to work with us

| | Our designs + your label | Your own designs |
|---|---|---|
| Best for | Fast launch, testing a market | A unique, exclusive collection |
| You provide | Your labels and tags (or we arrange them) | Sketch, reference photos or tech pack |
| Changes possible | Colour, print, fabric, neckline, sleeve | Full development |
| Sample | 7 to 8 days | 7 to 8 days per style |
| MOQ | 15 to 20 pieces per design | 15 to 20 pieces per design |

## How private label production works

1. **Share your brief:** styles, quantities, target price and timeline on WhatsApp or email.
2. **Choose fabric, print and sizes:** we suggest options that suit your market and budget.
3. **Sample:** we make your sample in 7 to 8 days and send photos and videos. Physical samples can be couriered.
4. **Approve and pay the advance:** 50% advance to start bulk production.
5. **Production:** about 15 days for 100 pieces. Larger orders are planned with you.
6. **Quality check and labelling:** every piece is checked, labelled, tagged and packed with your branding.
7. **Photos before dispatch:** we send photos and videos, you pay the balance, and we ship.

## What private label includes

- Your **neck label** and **wash-care label**
- Your **hang tags** and **branded packaging**
- **Size sets** to your size chart
- **Photos and videos** before dispatch
- Production of **our designs** or **your own designs and tech packs**

## Who we work with

- Instagram, website and marketplace brands building their own label
- Boutiques in India and abroad that want exclusive styles
- Diaspora ethnic wear stores in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and the Middle East
- Designers who need a reliable production partner in Jaipur

Ready to start? [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886) with your styles and quantities, or fill the [wholesale enquiry form](/wholesale/#enquiry). See also our [hand block print kurti manufacturing](/hand-block-print-kurti-manufacturer-jaipur/) and [Indian kurti supplier for USA, UK and Europe](/indian-kurti-supplier-usa-uk-europe/) pages.

faq.q: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ) for private label?
faq.a: Our MOQ is 15 to 20 pieces per design. This makes it easy for new brands and boutiques to start small and test their market.

faq.q: How long does a sample take?
faq.a: A sample takes 7 to 8 days. We send photos and videos for approval, and we can courier the physical sample.

faq.q: How long does bulk production take?
faq.a: About 15 days for 100 pieces after the sample is approved and the advance is paid. Larger orders are planned with you.

faq.q: Will you put my brand name on the product?
faq.a: Yes. We attach your neck labels, wash-care labels, hang tags and packaging. You can send them to us or we can arrange them for you.

faq.q: Can you make my own designs or tech packs?
faq.a: Yes. Share a sketch, reference photos or a tech pack, and we develop the sample in 7 to 8 days.
50% advance to start production and the balance before dispatch.

faq.q: Do you ship private label orders outside India?
faq.a: Yes. We ship to the USA, UK, Europe, Canada, Australia and the Middle East. Import duties for wholesale orders depend on your country; we provide the commercial invoice and documents.

faq.q: Can I start a clothing brand with a small budget?
faq.a: Yes. With an MOQ of 15 to 20 pieces per design, you can launch a small first collection with our existing designs and your own label, then add custom designs as you grow.
